title: The Song of Judah's Strong City and God's Judgment
description: A song sung in Judah about the city with salvation as its walls and ramparts. It celebrates how God brings the exalted city low into the dust, while preserving the righteous in perfect peace. The song expresses a longing for the Lord's judgments upon the earth so that the world's inhabitants may learn righteousness, and confesses that only the name of the Lord is their master.
